propositions: The rate-limit sweep's file list is hardcoded in _step0_names() rather than derived, so a classified mutating method renamed or moved to an unswept module escapes detection.
Scanning all 8 unswept jira/ modules reveals exactly 2 collisions with _CLASSIFIED_MUTATING names: backend.py::set_relationship and backend.py::add_comment, both pure transport delegations.
An AST-based anti-drift guard must accept only pure same-name self.transport delegations with unchanged argument forwarding and reject any guard, retry, logging, transform, or nested hiding.
The sweep's scope must remain the declared four transport modules, not glob-expanded to all 90 members in 12 modules, preserving the correct transport-layer scoping from ticket 8a5e.
Known benign collisions must be explicitly declared and asserted unchanged; new accepted facades require deliberate 429-policy judgement rather than silent drift.
